exposure: Total hysteroscopic treatment with a 2-step technique (using 5-mm hysteroscopy and 10-mm resectoscopy)
outcome: Efficacy and safety of the surgical treatment for ectopic cervical pregnancy
Resolution of ectopic pregnancy (negative beta human chorionic gonadotropin serum level, regular ultrasound cervical findings)
cohort: A 41-year-old woman with an ultrasound diagnosis of ectopic cervical pregnancy at 6 + 6 weeks of gestation.
finding: The total hysteroscopic approach with a 2-step technique offers an effective, safe, and minimally invasive surgical treatment for ectopic cervical pregnancy, leading to resolution and subsequent successful intrauterine implantation.
